ladder.label: DOWNTREND
ladder.why: Failed cycle — price broke below the low that started this cycle, which historically means the larger trend is rolling over (~80% of cases).
ladder.next: Stand aside until a new daily cycle low forms and confirms.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle failed (broke its start low)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum just crossed down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle failed (broke its start low) (investor cycle week 9 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 7d ago).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
⚠ Failed cycle — price broke below the low that began this cycle (7d ago)

entry.text: Downtrend — stand aside until a new cycle low forms and confirms.
entry.text_zh: 下跌趋势——观望，直至新的周期低点形成并确认。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 21 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 21 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 9 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 9 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点，历史上这通常意味着更大的趋势正在掉头向下（约 80% 的情形）。
ladder.next_zh: 观望，直至新的日线周期低点形成并确认。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量刚刚向下交叉；3 日线向下交叉；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）（投资者周期第 9 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期于 7 天前跌破其起始低点）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：下跌趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
⚠ 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点（7 天前）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ DOWNTREND signal triggered 5 trading days ago (~2026-06-05), switching from TOPPING. Signal strength: strong (score -80/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 下跌趋势信号于 5 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-05），自做顶中切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 -80/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健卖出/离场形态（-45）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
